status: hand-edited source of truth for visual tokens; runtime validation tracked in docs/validation.md

source.editing: Edit this file by hand. Nothing generates it.
source.generatedHeader: src/vi_tokens.h, written by tools/gen-vi-tokens.ps1 (run by tools/build.ps1 and CMake); 'tools/gen-vi-tokens.ps1 -Check' fails when the committed header is stale
source.units: DIP unless a key ends in Ms (milliseconds); scales and opacities are unitless
source.colorFormat: '#RRGGBB' is opaque; {"hex": "#RRGGBB", "alpha": 0..1} is translucent and composites over the plate
source.curveFormat: cubic-bezier control points [x1, y1, x2, y2]
source.versions: schemaVersion is the VI's version (v0.9, output/pdf/copilot-reel-vi-v0.9.pdf); appVersion is the build these tokens describe, one of the version copies tools/check-versions.ps1 keeps equal

rendering: Direct2D vector geometry, DirectWrite text and Segoe Fluent Icons command glyphs on Windows.UI.Composition surfaces; vendor artwork from source-appropriate SVG or PNG; system and custom apps from their Shell icons

geometry.scaleNote: the reel draws every DIP value below at this fraction: the effective DPI is round(monitor DPI x scale), so placement, hit testing, surfaces and artwork stay on one device-pixel grid (a 192 DPI display draws the 384 DIP canvas at 616 px). A capture DPI override is the monitor DPI and is scaled the same way
geometry.sizeNote: the user's reel size (Settings hub > Reel size, preferences.ini ReelSize): one step multiplies scale, so the effective DPI is round(monitor DPI x scale x step) and every DIP value, the edge clamp and the work-area shrink follow it unchanged; step 1 is the default

orbit.numbering: from 0, as menu indices: slot 0 is at firstSlot, slot i is i steps further in direction (SlotAngle in src/renderer.cpp)

seat.relation: concentric with the r10 tile plus 4 DIP; replaces the selected item's neutral tile fill

glyph.alignment: centered on the glyph's ink bounds inside the tile
glyph.tuning: 24 DIP chosen from native 20/22/24 comparisons: the Fluent 1/16 em stroke (1.5 DIP) and extents match the vendor marks; 24 px is a native Fluent size at 100%

artwork.note: optical box for glyph-class marks; plated marks fill the 40 DIP tile

badge.dotMinimumNote: the dot keeps scaling with the reel down to a disc of dotMinimumPx device pixels in radius, never larger than the check badge's disc; its ring stays dotRingRadius - dotRadius wider (typography.minimumPx)
badge.dot: an accent disc without the check at the same position: an update is ready (the hub's About tile and the update tile on About)
badge.check: path with round caps and joins in textOnAccent; the plate-colored ring reads as a cutout

switch.note: em of the command glyph, from its center: the knob of an on switch, cut out of ToggleFilled where ToggleRight (F19F) draws its knob

chevrons.position: adjust chevron centers at (+-offset, orbitY) from the plate center, beside slot 0, the EN/ZH/JA tile on the hub; hit boxes hit x hit, except the square of half-size badge.offset + badge.ringRadius around slot 0, which belongs to the tile

trash.idle: while an app tile is dragged on Manage apps: the Remove glyph (E74D) at em in critical, inside a centerZone.radius ring of ringStroke in critical
trash.armed: pointer inside the center zone: a criticalFill disc of armedRadius with the glyph in textOnCritical, over the shrunken tile; the idle ring stays

geometry.pixelGrid: snap item centers, tile and seat rectangles to device pixels at draw/offset time (v = round(v * s) / s, s = dpi / 96); hairlines are max(1 px, round(w * s)) device pixels, half-pixel aligned when odd; hit testing keeps exact geometry

elevation.recipe: one soft directional shadow (Fluent flyout elevation), baked once per DPI and theme into its own surface with the D2D Shadow effect of the plate disk, then the disk (radius plate.radius - 1) knocked out so nothing draws under a translucent plate

highContrast.source: live GetSysColor values; these are role mappings, not colors
highContrast.tile: COLOR_WINDOW with a 1 DIP COLOR_WINDOWTEXT stroke
highContrast.critical: COLOR_WINDOWTEXT (no contrast-theme role means destructive; the glyph carries it)
highContrast.selection: COLOR_HIGHLIGHT seat fill with a geometry.seat.strokeHighContrast COLOR_HIGHLIGHTTEXT stroke
highContrast.selectionText: COLOR_HIGHLIGHTTEXT (selected command glyphs and the monogram)
highContrast.material: solid; no shadow; motion durations use reducedMotion

previewSample.note: illustrative High Contrast Black values for VI previews only

palettes.mix: Mix(a, b, t) = a + (b - a) * t per channel, opaque
palettes.accentRule: accent comes from UISettings.GetColorValue ramp steps named above, else the fallback; never draw raw UIColorType::Accent on the plate

colorPolicy.surface: Windows neutral plate: #F9F9F9 light / #2C2C2C dark, the WinUI acrylic fallback colors
colorPolicy.accent: system accent ramp. On the reel: the seat stroke, the seat tint and the badge disc (the preferred check and the update dot), nothing else; never the switches. In the native editor: focus outlines and primary buttons' outlines, the seat tint on selected rows and on pressed and primary buttons, and accentText for a focused page tile's icon
colorPolicy.critical: WinUI SystemFillColorCritical (#C42B1C light / #FF99A4 dark) for the drag trash only; nothing else is red
colorPolicy.glyphsOnSelection: command glyphs and the EN/ZH/JA monogram stay foreground when selected; the seat alone carries selection (high contrast uses selectionText)
colorPolicy.vendorArtwork: preserve official proportions and colors; never recolor, redraw or distort
colorPolicy.highContrast: actual system colors; previewSample is illustrative only

typography.fallbackWhen: FindFamilyName fails for the preferred family

small.note: Segoe UI Variable's caption optical master: text drawn below belowPx device pixels uses it, larger text the preferred Text master; the cap height comes from the face actually chosen

minimumPx.note: approved 2026-10-25 (design/vi/proposals/2026-10-25-audit, P1): geometry keeps scaling with geometry.scale and the size step, but the center name and the EN/ZH/JA and Reel size monograms never draw below these device-pixel sizes; a raised size is at most maxGrowth times its DIP size, which only a work area smaller than the reel reaches
minimumPx.labelNote: 10, not the proposed 11 (2026-10-25): at 11 px the 70% step at 100% scaling trimmed Visual Studio Code, whose text then needed about 94 px of a 90 px line; at 10 px it fits

cjk.builder: one custom fallback (IDWriteFactory2::CreateFontFallbackBuilder) applied with IDWriteTextFormat1::SetFontFallback to every reel text format and to the D2D text formats in src/osd.cpp

japanese.source: Noto Sans JP 2.004 (Source Han Sans, SIL Open Font License 1.1): static 400 and 600 instances subset to Windows-31J, kana, CJK symbols and the interface strings, renamed, with Segoe UI's line metrics (tools/build-fonts.py)
japanese.rule: text whose locale is ja-JP (the Japanese interface, or any name that contains kana) maps Han, CJK punctuation and these kana ranges to the bundled family, then to the system family for characters outside its subset; in other locales only kana take that mapping and Han keeps the cjk family; the native editor's GDI controls use the system family

locales.rebuild: OrbitRenderer::SetLanguage rebuilds the text formats and the fallback

applicationLabel.widthNote: 160 since 2026-10-25 (was 132): wide enough for the names a 14 DIP line trimmed, and clear of every seat that reaches the name's band, with the band grown by minimumPx.maxGrowth (tests/typography_tests.cpp)
applicationLabel.heightNote: the box grows with a size raised by minimumPx
applicationLabel.verticalCenter: cap height from IDWriteTextLayout metrics, not the paragraph box
applicationLabel.position: box centered on the plate center

sizeStep.note: the Reel size tile shows its step in the icon itself, smaller so four characters stay inside the tile

interaction.singleTap: launch preferred local application; resolve recognized legacy website defaults through installed-app discovery; open native executable/shortcut picker when unavailable; never fall back to a website
interaction.hold: open at pointer center; release commits a target or opens the unified + hub
interaction.centerCancel: the center zone (geometry.centerZone.radius) cancels or returns one level
interaction.menuContinuation: secondary settings remain open for deliberate adjustment
interaction.back: center or Esc returns one level
interaction.disabledItems: keep their slot, draw tile and artwork at geometry.disabledOpacity, never show the seat and cannot be chosen; hover still shows the name
interaction.launch: short-lived COM STA worker thread, exactly once per commit; the commit animation never delays it; failures post back to the UI thread
interaction.hitTesting: WM_NCHITTEST returns HTTRANSPARENT while closing or when no gesture is active; geometry from src/core.h is unchanged

motion.implementation: Windows.UI.Composition animations only; no application frame timers
motion.origin: plate center (root CenterPoint); never the pointer
compositionTree: root: opacity and scale for open/close, CenterPoint = plate center
base visual: the baked shadow, the plate fill when solid and the rim, one surface
page containers, one per page: the seat (Offset from an Angle property), then a container per item with tile-fill visual and artwork sprite, then the language chevrons
motion.interruption: every animated property starts from its current presentation value; a new transition finishes the old one at once and removes its outgoing page
motion.outgoingPages: removed when their CompositionScopedBatch completes (UI dispatcher)

commit.detail: plate, other items and label fade out over fadeMs; the selected item (seat and artwork) holds full opacity for holdMs, then fades over fadeMs while scaling 1 -> pressScale -> 1 over pressMs; then detach
commit.launch: starts immediately and never waits for this animation

travel.path: along the orbit: Angle scalar, shortest arc (delta normalized to [-pi, pi]); seat Offset = center + orbit.radius * (cos, sin) by ExpressionAnimation
travel.overshoot: none: critically damped (dampingRatio 1), so the seat settles on its slot without passing it, in about 140 ms, as every easing curve stays within its end values
travel.idle: stop the expression when idle so DWM stops producing frames

selection.noneToItem: seat placed at the item angle without travel; opacity 0 -> 1 over seatFadeMs linear; scale seatAppearScaleFrom -> 1 over seatAppearMs; tile fill -> 0 over tileFillFadeMs
selection.itemToItem: seat travels along the orbit; old tile fill -> 1 and new tile fill -> 0 over tileFillFadeMs
selection.itemToNone: seat opacity -> 0 over seatFadeMs; tile fill -> 1 over tileFillFadeMs

centerLabel.sequence: one thing at a time: what leaves the center (a name, the ring, the back chevron, the trash) clears in clearMs; what enters waits until it has, then fades in over crossfadeMs (the ring over ringHideMs)

drillOut.use: Back, return after save or remove

handoff.labelNote: the outgoing name clears within two frames, before the clone reaches the center (captured v0.3.4: the drill curve covers most of the distance in about 60 ms)
handoff.detail: a clone of the tapped item's artwork and tile travels in a straight line from its slot to the center while scaling 1 -> scaleTo, fading out over the last fadeMs while the new page's back chevron fades in; the tapped item in the outgoing page hides at once

drag.use: Manage apps: drag an app tile to reorder it or drop it on the trash
drag.detail: the lifted tile follows the pointer without easing; the other apps travel to their open slots over reflowMs; over the armed trash the tile shrinks to overTrashScale at overTrashOpacity; after a drop every app settles from where it is to its saved slot over settleMs; a removed tile falls into the trash over removeMs while the trash fades

reducedMotion.completion: same code path; completion still fires

notAllowed: overshooting or elastic motion, the seat's spring included
motion.reduceMotion: same code path with every duration = reducedMotion.durationMs
motion.hidden: detach composition tree; stop active animations

frosted.source: Compositor.CreateHostBackdropBrush, already blurred by the shell; no extra GaussianBlur
frosted.graph: HostBackdrop -> Blend(Luminosity) with ColorSource(luminosity color) -> Blend(Color) with ColorSource(tint) -> Composite with the noise tile
frosted.effects: Windows.UI.Composition effects through IGraphicsEffectD2D1Interop adapters; no Win2D
frosted.blendModeMapping: WinUI notes that the Color and Luminosity blend modes are swapped in the D2D mapping; verify visually and record the outcome in blendModeVerified
frosted.plateFill: transparent on the D2D surface where the backdrop shows
fallbackToSolidWhen: CompositionCapabilities reports effects unsupported or slow
frosted.preview: VI frosted scenes are tonal illustrations; the native backdrop needs runtime captures

systemAppearance.delivery: coalesce on UI thread; preserve menu context and selection; SetAppearance is idempotent

iconography.renderer: Segoe Fluent Icons command glyphs; verified vendor artwork; Shell icons for system and custom apps
iconography.vectorFallback: paths with one ID2D1StrokeStyle (round caps and joins), each polyline one figure, at geometry.glyph.fallbackStroke

commandGlyphNotes.GenericApp: window with a title bar (E737); AppIconDefault (ECAA) reads as an unrelated layout glyph
commandGlyphNotes.ChevronLeftSmall: regular ChevronLeft/Right (E76B/E76C) at geometry.chevrons.em: the small variants E96F/E970 are bold and outweigh the 1/16 em family
commandGlyphNotes.Check: the preferred-badge check is a path, not a font glyph
commandGlyphNotes.About: Info (E946): the hub's About tile. About is the reel's own mark (copilot-reel, named by the version), GitHub's Invertocat (github-light / github-dark, named by the author and linking to the repository), two switches and the update tile
commandGlyphNotes.Switch: a switch shows its state in the icon, as a Windows toggle switch does: off is ToggleLeft (F19E, outlined, knob left); on is ToggleFilled (EC11) with the knob cut out on the right (geometry.switch), so the tile or the seat shows through it; never accent-colored
commandGlyphNotes.Update: CheckUpdate (Refresh E72C) checks; CheckFailed (SyncError EA6A) after a failed check; Download (E896) installs a found update and carries the badge dot while it waits
commandGlyphNotes.Tray: the notification-area menu: View (E890) beside Preview, Settings (E713) beside Quick menu, Diagnostic (E9D9), PowerButton (E7E8) beside Exit; small-icon size (SM_CXSMICON) in the foreground of the menu's mode, none in high contrast; the native popup menu in the Windows mode's light or dark theme (SystemUsesLightTheme, as the taskbar's own menus and the monochrome icon; the app mode returns once it closes), Preview bold as the click default; Monochrome icon is a check item without a glyph
commandGlyphNotes.TrayIcon: the notification-area icon at SM_CXSMICON for the system DPI: the packaged color ICO's own small frame, or (TrayIcon=monochrome in preferences.ini) iconography.orbitMark without its plate, in white on a dark taskbar and black on a light one (SystemUsesLightTheme, not the app mode) and COLOR_WINDOWTEXT in high contrast: a margin and a minimum stroke of 1/16 of the icon, both rounded to whole pixels, so 1 px up to 20 px (the outer orbit and the dot only) and 2 px from 24. The hub's Tray icon tile draws the same mark in the glyph color while the icon is monochrome, as wide as the color mark on its plate (orbitMark.extent of the 40 DIP tile, 28.75 DIP) so the two states differ only in color, its stroke never under 1/14 of the mark (the tray icon's proportion): the outer orbit and the dot at the 70% and 85% steps on a 100% display

orbitMark.note: The Soft Orbit mark in its 256-unit icon canvas: a plate of radius 56, an outer ring whose outer edge has radius 92 (so the rings span extent) and an inner one of 56, each stroke wide inside its radius and running clockwise from From to To degrees (0 at 3 o'clock, y down), and a dot of radius 16 centered on the outer edge at dotAngle. tools/generate-assets.py rasterizes it on its plate for the package icons and the copilot-reel brand PNG; src/orbit_mark.h draws it alone on the device-pixel grid: the rings' edges on whole pixels, the stroke rounded to whole pixels and never under the caller's minimum, the dot never under minimumDotPx in radius, and the inner ring only from innerRingFromStrokePx, so a one-pixel mark is the outer orbit and the dot (P3 of the 2026-10-25 audit, N3 and N5 of 2026-10-26).

classes.command: internal reel:* command glyph on the neutral tile
classes.plated: artwork with its own filled plate (alpha coverage of its bounding box >= 0.90 and a rounded-rectangle silhouette): cropped to its plate, scaled to cover the 40 DIP tile, clipped to the tile radius, tile hairline on top; no neutral tile beneath
classes.glyph: open mark without a plate on the neutral tile, scaled so its optical size matches geometry.artwork.keyline times opticalScale
classes.generic: no artwork: GenericApp glyph on the neutral tile

iconography.rasterQuality: decode and pre-scale each raster to the exact device-pixel size with WIC (HighQualityCubic or Fant) and draw 1:1; other sizes use D2D1_INTERPOLATION_MODE_HIGH_QUALITY_CUBIC; cache keyed by (source, pixel size), released on DPI change and device loss
iconography.shellIcons: Windows Settings, Notepad and custom targets without vendor artwork use their Shell icon (SHCreateItemFromParsingName + IShellItemImageFactory::GetImage 256 px, SIIGBF_ICONONLY | SIIGBF_BIGGERSIZEOK), classified by alpha like vendor art, prepared in PrepareArtwork and never in draw; ms-settings: targets use the Settings AUMID icon
iconography.identity: by target, never by display name: AUMID package-family prefix, exe or lnk file name plus its install folder name, URL host; the display name is consulted only when the target is empty
iconography.rasterException: official PNG or same-artwork PNG when SVG unavailable or unsupported; never UI animation frames

brandSchema.key: asset key from assets/brands (file stem such as 'claude' or 'chatgpt-dark') or a stable Shell identity key; characters A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : ! + -; unique
brandSchema.opticalScale: multiplier on geometry.artwork.keyline for glyph marks (round marks slightly above 1, dense square marks slightly below 1, for equal perceived mass); 1 for plated marks
brandSchema.content: [left, top, right, bottom], normalized 0..1 in the source artwork canvas: the plate bounds for plated marks (e.g. DSH decoded-256 (8, 8, 248, 248) -> [0.03125, 0.03125, 0.96875, 0.96875]), the ink bounds for glyph marks

osd.trayIcon: the hub's fourth tile (added 2026-10-26) switches the notification-area icon between color and monochrome, as the tray menu's Monochrome icon does, and shows the choice in the icon itself: the reel's own plated mark (copilot-reel) while the icon is in color, the Soft Orbit mark alone in the glyph color (iconography.commandGlyphNotes.TrayIcon) while it is monochrome; the hub stays open and the tile stays selected

language.location: unified + hub / language tile at 12 o'clock
input: Left and Right while the tile is selected
language.arrowColor: secondary; foreground while the Language item is selected

reorder.location: Manage apps: drag an app tile with the pointer
reorder.start: a press on an app tile that moves farther than the system drag threshold (SM_CXDRAG / SM_CYDRAG) lifts it; a press that does not move stays a click and opens the app's actions
reorder.drag: the lifted tile follows the pointer at motion.events.drag.liftScale; the other apps slide along the orbit to open the slot nearest the pointer's angle; Add keeps its slot
reorder.trash: the center shows the trash (geometry.trash) while a tile is lifted; inside the center zone it arms and the tile shrinks beneath it
reorder.drop: on a slot: the reel saves the new order; on the armed trash: the app leaves the reel and waits on Add with its settings; elsewhere or on Esc: everything returns
reorder.keyboard: A / D move the selected app one place; Delete takes it out of the reel
reorder.lastApp: the trash draws at disabledOpacity and never arms while one app remains
reorder.persistence: immediate; the preferred agent stays the same app, or becomes the first app when the preferred one leaves

appActions: Remove from reel (more than one app)
osd.parked: an app taken out of the reel keeps its settings in parked.ini and is offered first on Add app, most recent first, at most 16
osd.backChevron: idle submenu center: Segoe Fluent Icons BackChevron at geometry.chevrons.backEm in secondary, one glyph so overlapping strokes never alpha-blend
osd.selection: 48 x 48 DIP r14 seat in place of the item's neutral tile fill; accent stroke; glyphs stay foreground
osd.centerRing: idle: 1 DIP ringIdle; hidden while a center label is visible
osd.addAppAtCapacity: Manage apps and the + hub keep the Add app slot at maxApps as a disabled item, without reflow
management: apps taken out of the reel, then presets, five items per page
osd.editor: focused native task sheet for name and actual launch target
osd.missingPreset: open focused local-target editor; do not substitute a website
osd.defaultTargets: up to six installed native applications, then Notepad and Windows Settings
osd.legacyMigration: known ChatGPT and Claude base-URL defaults only; back up configuration before automatic save; preserve arbitrary/custom URLs
osd.missingPreferredTarget: native Choose a local application picker restricted to exe/lnk; replace selected launch profile before opening
osd.customWebTargets: explicit wheel selection only; never a short-tap fallback
osd.centerContent: empty on idle Main (only the faint ring); back chevron on idle submenus; one concise functional name for the selected app or secondary command; the trash alone while an app tile is dragged
osd.centerLabelPolicy: show the hovered item name, including Language, Appearance, Reel size, Tray icon, Manage apps, Add app and About; never add a second line or helper prompt
osd.appearanceIcon: sun for system light mode; moon for system dark mode

edgeLayout.interior: center the complete reel on the actual pointer with zero offset
edgeLayout.edge: clamp complete footprint to current monitor work area
edgeLayout.corner: preserve circle and minimally clamp both axes
edgeLayout.origin: final visible center is the hit-test origin for selection by direction
edgeLayout.opening: the plate opens centered on its final position; no line from the pointer, no perimeter sweep, no transform origin at the pointer
edgeLayout.selection: wherever clamping leaves the pointer, on the plate or outside it, select by direction from the plate center once the pointer has moved; the opening position itself never selects, and a release before the pointer moves cancels. There is no center entry (removed 2026-10-26 at the user's request; 0.3.5.1 to 0.3.10 waited for it when the pointer was outside the plate)
edgeLayout.smallWorkArea: scale the complete canvas uniformly; validate reduced text and target sizes
edgeLayout.layoutContract: rendering and hit testing share final center and geometry

handoff.svg: editable vector UI scenes with embedded verified source artwork
handoff.pdf: embedded fonts and vector UI; official PNG sources retained for review
